In Autumn 2009 further work was undertaken from Maxi Haulage and as a result another lorry was purchased in early 2010.
Continued expansion and exploration of more haulage options both in NI and in GB meant that 6 new units were purchased between 2013 and 2014 with a further 2 arriving in 2015 including a brand new Scania 580.
Now boasting over 15 employees, we are conveniently located in Enkalon Industrial Estate, Antrim almost equidistant from the ports of Belfast and Larne.
Our large warehouse provides customers with storage options for their products and we also have an in-house workshop and paint spraying facilities.

– Offering a dedicated service throughout Great Britain and Ireland, all fridges are multi-temp ensuring we can meet every customer’s needs.
Dry Freight Transport
– Fleet of Curtainsiders working throughout Great Britain and Ireland, we offer Next Day service for express consignments and an Economy service for less urgent loads.
Own fleet of Trailers
– All regularly inspected and tested, kept clean both inside and out.
Warehousing and Storage facilities – Large warehouse facilities to cope with ambient products. We can collect you goods and return them on demand, at a time convenient to you.
Cargo Sorting, Picking & Distribution
– For those customers who like to stockpile or stagger their output, BCT can meet all requirements.
– Our on site garage ensures that BCT can keep their machinery on the move at all times with mechanics to service both units and trailers.
Every Day Service
Service 24 hours a day, 365 days a year – A personal and efficient service is provided by our office staff. A point of contact is available 24 hours a day.
